about: How much tape a label takes, worked by hand for the label maker in device, as /api/capabilities serves it. The firmware and the panel each do these sums, in src/Tape.h and data/tape.js, and test/test_tape/test_tape.cpp and test/panel/tape.test.js hold both to these cases.

labels.case: the shortest label the panel sends is the minimum
a label is the lead and a feed per character
the longest label a request may carry
a short label is topped up to the minimum
a label one short of the minimum
a single letter is left short
an empty label still feeds a whole minimum
a negative length feeds as an empty label

fit.case: 3 m holds 107.1 of the panel's shortest label
3 m holds 93.75 labels of 7 characters, not 94
3 m of short labels, each topped up to the minimum
3 m of single letters, each left short
10 m holds 357.1 of the panel's shortest label
exactly one label left fits one
a millimetre short of one label fits none
less than nothing left fits nothing
